content:
tanvi: @channel quick triage — we have a cross-repo stack of PRs that need ordering/approvals to avoid a prod break. TL;DR: SDK #342 (adds new header param), API #811 (changes endpoint response shape), Console #210 (renders new field), Helm runtime chart #56 (image tag + env), Runtime PR #98 (compat flags). Can owners propose safe merge order and who can approve?
kevin: tiny note — API #811 changes response shape for /generate (adds choices[].meta). console will break if merged before console update.
alex: my proposal: 1) bump helm/runtime chart so runtime can deploy with feature flag off, 2) merge runtime PR with flag off, 3) merge SDK (it's additive), 4) merge API behind flag, 5) flip flag and merge console + enable canary.
lisa: console e2e already failing locally against API #811 branch — the shape change is breaking our serializer. can we keep the change backward-compatible?
kevin: we can add `choices[].meta = null` when absent to keep parity, but that still needs API tests.
aj: deploy-bot shows API #811 CI -> flaky integration test around kv-cache timeout, failing in azure region 3. patch is in progress (fix on the way).
deploy-bot: CI: API #811 — build passed, unit tests passed, integration-linux-1 failed (kv-cache timeout), retry queued.
sam: I can approve SDK #342 once CI is green and it has the changelog entry + test for header parsing. tagging @alex for final review.
alex: SDK is safe to merge before API if SDK accepts either header present/absent (we added fallback). SDK tests added. I'll review today.
lisa: console needs a small adapter to tolerate both old/new response. I can push a quick PR to console that handles missing meta fields — want to coordinate merge timing with API flag flip.
tanvi: sounds good. who can own the helm bump? if we bump chart first we can stage runtime without changing behavior.
kevin: I'll do the helm chart bump. plan: helm chart #56 will add `image.tag: runtime-2026-03-17` and `runtime.env.FEATURE_NEW_META: "off"`. I will open PR and request review from eng-runtime owners.
aj: runtime PR #98 needs image built — CI showing it's ready. once helm updated we can deploy canary with feature flag off.
alex: important: make sure SDK interop tests run against runtime canary + API branch. request: add matrix job: sdk-integ vs api-branch.
sam: I'll add that matrix entry to CI for SDK repo, point to API #811 branch — will be ready by EOD.
lisa: after console adapter lands, we can flip the flag in canary for 1% traffic, monitor errors (console has structured logging).
kevin: ops note — to rollback flag quickly: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime RUNTIME_FEATURE_NEW_META=off -n redwood-prod` (or use flags service). keep runbook handy.
tanvi: can owners add approvals here: SDK: @sam, @alex; API: @kevin, @aj; Runtime/Helm: @kevin; Console: @lisa.
aj: +1 on sequence. I'll keep an eye on API integration flakiness.
alex: I'll review SDK #342 now and leave comments.
sam: marking checklist: [ ] Helm bump PR opened, [ ] Runtime deployed canary (flag off), [ ] SDK merged, [ ] API merged (flagged), [ ] Console adapter merged, [ ] Flag canary flip (1%), [ ] Monitor 1hr, [ ] full rollout.
tanvi: thanks all — please ping here when each box done. I'll coordinate release notes entry and postmortem template if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
